method.collision: 15-axis SAT on full rectangular prisms using CARD_W/H/T, with physical thickness; >1e-6 world penetration is counted, including packets.
method.bounds: All corners after sceneFrame; camera z=10.4, vertical FOV 38 degrees. Header/footer bands are conservative geometry limits, not measured DOM text.
method.continuity: Largest sampled corner displacements are refined eight times at fixed animation state. A persistent nonzero displacement is reported as suspected, not mathematically proven, discontinuity.
method.limits: Finite sampling is not a proof of all-progress separation or continuity.
